podcast.title: Haisla Nation Origins
podcast.body: The duo Snotty Nose Rez Kids are members of the Haisla Nation in British Columbia, having grown up just south of Kitimat, a location that informs their perspective and music. "Their Snottie Knows Res Kids, members of the Heistler Nation in BC, they grew up just south of Kitimat."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Polaris Music Prize Finalists
podcast.body: They were short-list finalists for the Polaris Music Prize in 2018 with their album "The Average Savage," connecting them to a prestigious Canadian music award. "This duo also has a Polaris Music Prize connection. They made the short list of finalists in 2018 with their album The Average Savage."
